decisions.reason: The format reader and writer plug-ins build on the firm's established integration offer and have their own web page, so they are a visible product line likely to be maintained.
A building digital twin service fits the firm's strategy and current market trends, though it is only mentioned on the website and less established, so the risk of dropping it is moderate.
The authentication and delegation service overlaps with the identity service and could be merged into it, but it is cheap to maintain and supports integration, so keeping it is more likely.
An open GIS application development framework is core to the firm's open, extensible component strategy and underpins customer projects.
The identity service was actively promoted as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications and supports the firm's enterprise integration goals.
